high_level_description: A clean, high-resolution 1600x900 landscape structural draft featuring five isolated, vividly colored objects on a pale neutral background: a red tennis ball, a green garden hose with nozzle, a bicycle with wicker basket holding visibly wilted daisies, an ivy-covered pickup truck emphasizing its front hood, and a symmetrical quadcopter drone.

elements.desc: Red tennis ball — solid circle, centered top-left
Green garden hose with conical nozzle — horizontal S-curve shape in vivid green, top-center
Bicycle with upright frame, two wheels, handlebars, and front-mounted wicker basket containing 4 wilted daisies (yellow petals, brown centers), top-right
Ivy-covered pickup truck front hood — trapezoidal hood shape with grille and headlights, overlaid with irregular green ivy blobs, bottom-left
Drone — central square body with four straight arms and circular rotors, light cool gray, bottom-right
